roadmap.title: Clear the base story and collect everything
roadmap.description: Play on Casual or Standard, keep manual saves at every major area, follow the chronological file, goat, outhouse, window, recipe, and weapon-part route, and clear the incidental combat achievements before entering the Factory.

roadmap.title: Use the Extra Content Shop
roadmap.description: Spend CP on every figure and concept-art entry, view them to clear their new markers, and unlock the WCX, Karambit Knife, and Mercenaries prerequisites for later stages.

roadmap.title: Combine the Casual New Game+ challenges
roadmap.description: Carry the Karambit Knife into Casual New Game+, kill Uriaș in the first ambush, set up exactly 777 Lei, and finish under three hours with at most four heals, less than 10,000 Lei spent, and no prohibited weapon hits.

roadmap.title: Finish Village of Shadows and the economy cleanup
roadmap.description: Use New Game+ and infinite ammo to finish Village of Shadows, then buy the Rocket Pistol, remaining recipes, weapons, and all 22 customizable parts before crafting every base-game item.

roadmap.title: Earn the original Mercenaries S ranks
roadmap.description: Build a 30-kill combo and earn S or better on the four original stages and their four II variants; learn enemy routes and use the rank sheet beside the Duke for live thresholds.

roadmap.title: Complete Shadows of Rose
roadmap.description: Play Shadows of Rose on Hardcore so all three difficulty achievements stack, use mutamycete focus at least 20 times, and craft each of the four DLC item types.

roadmap.title: Clear Additional Orders
roadmap.description: Use Chris to earn A on Bloody Village to unlock Bloody River, then earn at least B on Bloody River.

achievements.description: Survive the lycan attack.
achievements.summary: Survive the opening @enemy{lycan ambush} in the village.

guide.context: This is an automatic story checkpoint during Ethan's first village visit.

steps.text: Keep moving, block attacks, and stay alive until the escape cutscene ends the ambush.

achievements.description: Escape the mine.
achievements.summary: Escape @loc{Heisenberg's mine} after the Four Lords meeting.

guide.context: The mine escape is mandatory and occurs immediately after Ethan is brought before Mother Miranda and the Four Lords.

steps.text: Follow the only route through the traps until Ethan escapes the mine.

achievements.description: Defeat the mutated Dimitrescu.
achievements.summary: Defeat mutated @enemy{Lady Dimitrescu} at the end of Castle Dimitrescu.

guide.context: The fight begins after Ethan obtains the dagger and cannot be skipped on the main story route.

steps.text: Damage Lady Dimitrescu's exposed humanoid body until the final tower phase ends.

achievements.description: Defeat Donna and Angie.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Donna Beneviento and Angie} in House Beneviento.

guide.context: This mandatory encounter replaces normal combat with a timed search through the house.

steps.text: Find Angie three times inside House Beneviento and complete the final attack.

achievements.description: Defeat the mutated Moreau.
achievements.summary: Defeat mutated @enemy{Moreau} at the Reservoir.

guide.context: Moreau becomes vulnerable after Ethan drains the Reservoir through the sluice-gate controls.

steps.text: Attack the humanoid body exposed inside Moreau's mouth and take cover from the acid rain until he dies.

achievements.description: Defeat Uriaș in the stronghold.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Uriaș} at the end of the Stronghold.

guide.context: This is the mandatory late-Stronghold version of Uriaș, separate from the optional opening-ambush kill required for Timber.

steps.text: Damage Uriaș throughout the circular arena until the mandatory Stronghold boss fight ends.

achievements.description: Place the Giant's Chalice in the ceremony site.
achievements.summary: Place the @item{Giant's Chalice} at the @loc{Ceremony Site}.

guide.context: The Giant's Chalice becomes usable only after Ethan has recovered all four lord flasks.

steps.text: Return to the Ceremony Site and insert the Giant's Chalice into the central mechanism.

achievements.description: Defeat the mutated Heisenberg.
achievements.summary: Defeat mutated @enemy{Heisenberg} at the Factory.

guide.context: The battle begins after Ethan assembles the vehicle and rides the Factory elevator.

steps.text: Destroy Heisenberg's glowing weak points with the vehicle's weapons.
Continue attacking after Ethan is thrown from the vehicle until the story finishes the fight.

achievements.description: Find the Megamycete in the underground ruins.
achievements.summary: Reach the @item{Megamycete} in the underground ruins during Chris's story section.

guide.context: Control switches to Chris after Heisenberg; the underground route is mandatory and leads through the Urias Strajer fight.

steps.text: Follow Chris's objective markers through the village and underground ruins until he finds the Megamycete.

achievements.description: Finish the story on at least Casual difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Ethan's story on @mechanic{Casual difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: Difficulty completion achievements stack, so Standard, Hardcore, or Village of Shadows also awards this one.

steps.text: Complete the final Miranda fight and finish the story on Casual or any higher setting.

achievements.description: Finish the story on at least Standard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Ethan's story on @mechanic{Standard difficulty} or higher.

guide.context: Hardcore and Village of Shadows completions also award the Standard and Casual achievements.

steps.text: Complete the full story and defeat Miranda on Standard, Hardcore, or Village of Shadows.

achievements.description: Finish the story on at least Hardcore difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Ethan's story on @mechanic{Hardcore difficulty} or Village of Shadows.

guide.context: A later Village of Shadows completion stacks this achievement, so a separate Hardcore run is optional.

steps.text: Complete the full story and defeat Miranda on Hardcore or Village of Shadows.

achievements.description: Finish the story on the Village of Shadows difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Ethan's story on @mechanic{Village of Shadows difficulty}.

guide.context: Village of Shadows normally unlocks after the first story completion. New Game+ inventory and infinite ammo remain eligible for achievements.

steps.text: Load a completed-story save into New Game+ and bring an infinite-ammo weapon; a fully upgraded @item{S.T.A.K.E.} is the strongest option.

Create a manual save while the required 2,103,000 Lei remains unspent, purchase every S.T.A.K.E. upgrade, and unlock its infinite-ammo bonus. Reload that earlier save to recover the Lei while retaining access to the bonus.
Start Village of Shadows through the completed save and finish the full story, including Miranda.

achievements.description: Craft an item in the Crafting menu.
achievements.summary: Craft any item from the @mechanic{Crafting menu}.

guide.context: Reaching the village automatically adds two recipes: First Aid Med and Handgun Ammo.

steps.text: Open the Crafting tab when either starting recipe shows that its required materials are available, then make a First Aid Med or Handgun Ammo.

achievements.description: Purchase something from the Duke in the story.
achievements.summary: Buy any priced item from @npc{the Duke} during Ethan's story.

guide.context: The Duke first opens his shop in the vineyard before Castle Dimitrescu; free offers do not satisfy the purchase requirement.

steps.text: Open the Duke's shop and spend Lei on any item with a nonzero price.

achievements.description: Unlock a simple lock with a lockpick.
achievements.summary: Use a @item{Lockpick} to open any simple locked cupboard or drawer.

guide.context: Lockpicks and simple locks appear repeatedly, so this does not depend on a specific chapter or container.

steps.text: Collect a Lockpick during the story.
Approach a drawer or cupboard marked as a simple lock and choose the Lockpick to open it.

achievements.description: Combine a treasure into its complete form.
achievements.summary: Combine the @item{Silver Ring} and @item{Azure Eye} into the Azure Eye Ring in Castle Dimitrescu.

guide.context: Both components are marked combinable treasures; selling either component removes this castle opportunity from the current run.

steps.text: Use the Iron Insignia Key on the Castle B2 dungeon gate, blow open the cracked wall, light both torches, and take the Azure Eye from the sarcophagus.
Open the drawer in the @loc{Hall of Pleasure 2F} and take the Silver Ring.
Select either component in the inventory and combine the Silver Ring with the Azure Eye.

achievements.description: Hunt an animal during the story.
achievements.summary: Kill any @enemy{chicken, fish, pig, or goat} during Ethan's story.

guide.context: Crows belong to a different achievement and do not count as hunted animals.

steps.text: After animals begin appearing in the village, kill one chicken, fish, pig, or goat with any weapon.

achievements.description: Solve a Labyrinth.
achievements.summary: Solve the Castle Dimitrescu Labyrinth with the @item{Flower Swords Ball}.

guide.context: Only one of the game's four Labyrinths is required, and the castle puzzle is the earliest.

steps.text: On the @loc{Opera Hall 2F} walkway, enter the side room beside the breakable window and open its chest for the Flower Swords Ball.
Return to the @loc{1F Merchant's Room}, insert the ball into the miniature castle beside the Duke, and tilt the maze until the ball reaches the goal.

achievements.description: Move the ball from the Winterses' bedroom into the study.
achievements.summary: Push the yellow ball from @loc{Rose's upstairs bedroom} into Ethan's adjacent laptop study during the prologue.

guide.context: The house cannot be revisited after the prologue, so use the ball immediately after carrying Rose upstairs.

steps.text: After placing Rose in her bed, walk into the yellow ball repeatedly until it crosses the doorway into the room containing Ethan's laptop.

achievements.description: Shoot down five flying crows in the story.
achievements.summary: Shoot five @enemy{crows} while they are flying during Ethan's story.

guide.context: Grounded crows do not count. The second village visit groups six crows close together, and checkpoint restarts can repeat the flock.

steps.text: On the village return from Castle Dimitrescu, ready the shotgun for four crows feeding in the Graveyard and another two near the Fallow Plot entrance.
Approach each group and shoot only after the crows leave the ground, continuing until five airborne kills have registered.

achievements.description: Open the door to every outhouse in the village in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Open all 10 eligible village @loc{outhouses} in one playthrough.

guide.context: Outhouse progress resets between runs, and the permanently locked outhouse near the first stop is not one of the ten.

collectibles.name: West Old Town first visit
collectibles.location: Yard behind the first traversed house
collectibles.method: Enter the first house ahead, leave through its right side, and open the outhouse in the rear yard.

collectibles.name: Luiza's House
collectibles.location: Right corner in front of Luiza's House
collectibles.method: After climbing through the window and over the left wall, open the outhouse before entering Luiza's House.

collectibles.name: Post-castle typewriter hut
collectibles.location: Behind the first snowy hut after Castle Dimitrescu
collectibles.method: After defeating Dimitrescu, enter the hut containing Craftsman's Note and the typewriter, then open the outhouse behind it.

collectibles.name: Leonardo's Message house
collectibles.location: Backyard of the house right of Maiden of War
collectibles.method: Read Leonardo's Message upstairs, then go into the backyard and open the outhouse.

collectibles.name: Green outhouse
collectibles.method: On the second village visit, follow the mandatory route through the house immediately after Outhouse 4, push the shelf blocking the exit, step outside, and open the green outhouse near the lycan.

collectibles.name: Iron Insignia gate
collectibles.location: West Old Town after the tractor
collectibles.method: Use the Jack Handle, crawl beneath the tractor, pass the clawed enemy, and open the outhouse in front of the Iron Insignia gate.

collectibles.name: Missing Owners yard
collectibles.method: Turn away from Outhouse 6, break the yellow padlock on the gate with the Missing Owners note, and open the outhouse inside.

collectibles.name: Red Chimney route
collectibles.location: Chicken yard beyond the Well Wheel ladder
collectibles.method: Go through the Iron Insignia gate, collect the Well Wheel, climb the yellow ladder, drop into the next yard, and open the white outhouse.

collectibles.name: Gardener's House
collectibles.location: Left side of the Gardener's House
collectibles.method: On the return from House Beneviento, climb toward the typewriter house, circle its left side, and open the outhouse.

collectibles.name: Reservoir Gatehouse
collectibles.method: Leave the building containing the Duke and the sluice controls, turn right, and open the final outhouse behind the Gatehouse.

achievements.description: Break every breakable window in Castle Dimitrescu in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{20/20} by breaking every counted @loc{Castle Dimitrescu window}; the first breaks automatically during the Bela fight.

guide.context: The counter includes one pane shattered automatically when Ethan exposes Bela to cold air, plus 19 panes the player must break. Finish the sweep before placing all four masks because the castle cannot be revisited afterward.

collectibles.name: Window 1
collectibles.method: Trigger the first Dimitrescu daughter fight; Ethan automatically shoots out this window during the opening struggle.

collectibles.name: Window 2
collectibles.method: After defeating Bela, break the other intact window in the same room.

collectibles.name: Windows 3-4
collectibles.method: Break both exterior windows in the Dining Room.

collectibles.name: Windows 5-6
collectibles.method: From the Courtyard, pass through the silver doors and break both windows on the stairs toward the statue puzzle.

collectibles.name: Windows 7-9
collectibles.method: Continue upstairs and break the three hallway windows before the statue-puzzle room.

collectibles.name: Windows 10-12
collectibles.method: Break two windows inside the phone chamber and the window at the end of its exterior balcony.

collectibles.name: Windows 13-15
collectibles.method: Enter the Opera Hall from the Courtyard and break the three windows along the stairs from 1F to 2F.

collectibles.name: Windows 16-18
collectibles.method: Break the two windows on the south side and the single window beside the Flower Swords Ball room.

collectibles.name: Window 19
collectibles.method: Break the hallway window immediately after the Library daughter fight.

collectibles.name: Window 20
collectibles.method: During the five-bells puzzle, break the ceiling window needed to shoot the outdoor bell.

achievements.description: Shoot down a Soldat hanging from the production line in the Factory.
achievements.summary: Shoot a suspended @enemy{Soldat} off the production line in Heisenberg's Factory.

guide.context: The first reliable line of hanging bodies is on Factory B4 near the Duke's merchant elevator.

steps.text: After first climbing into the B4 production-line area, aim at one hanging Soldat and keep shooting until the body drops from its suspension.

achievements.description: Push away an enemy after guarding in the story.
achievements.summary: Shove an @enemy{attacker} immediately after blocking its strike.

guide.context: The shove is a follow-up guard input, not a normal melee attack.

steps.text: Hold the guard input until an enemy attack connects with Ethan's block.
Press guard again immediately after the impact to push the attacker away.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy from long range with the sniper rifle in the story.
achievements.summary: Kill a distant @enemy{Samca} with the @item{F2 Rifle} from Castle Dimitrescu's rooftops.

guide.context: The F2 Rifle sits directly on the attic exit path, and flying Samcas appear outside as soon as Ethan reaches the roof.

steps.text: Take the F2 Rifle from the chair at the Castle attic exit.
On the rooftops, aim at a Samca far across the castle and kill it with the rifle before moving close.

achievements.description: Defeat at least three enemies with one attack in the story.
achievements.summary: Eliminate a group of three or more @enemy{enemies} with a single explosion or shot.

guide.context: The Stronghold gate encounter groups many Lycans beside explosive barrels, providing a predictable setup.

steps.text: At the Stronghold entrance with the two gate levers, draw at least three Lycans beside one red barrel.
Shoot the barrel so the same explosion kills all three; a pipe bomb, mine, grenade round, or penetrating magnum shot also works.

achievements.description: Set fire to a Moroaică in the story.
achievements.summary: Ignite a @enemy{Moroaică} with the hanging brazier in the @loc{Riverbank Treasure House}.

guide.context: The route opens only after Moreau, when the Crank can lower the Lone Road drawbridge; Moroaică respawn indefinitely inside the puzzle room.

steps.text: Lower the @loc{Lone Road} drawbridge with the Crank, take the boat upstream, disembark, and enter the Riverbank Treasure House.
Shoot the hanging brazier so it lights the two fixed torches.
Let a Moroaică approach, then shoot the brazier toward her until the flame touches and ignites her.

achievements.description: Knock a flaming arrow out of the sky with a close combat weapon in the story.
achievements.summary: Deflect a flaming @item{arrow} in midair with the knife on the route to the Stronghold.

guide.context: Two elevated lycan archers remain after the ground group near the “Good Luck” sign, allowing repeated timing attempts.

steps.text: Pass the “Good Luck” sign, climb toward the Stronghold ruins, and eliminate the ground Lycans while leaving an elevated archer alive.
Face the archer with the knife equipped and swing just after a flaming arrow is fired so the blade hits it in flight.

achievements.description: Take down the Vârcolac Alfa in the story.
achievements.summary: Kill the optional @enemy{Vârcolac Alfa} in the Fallow Plot after defeating Moreau.

guide.context: The Alfa appears only on the fourth village visit and has far more health than the earlier Vârcolac enemies.

steps.text: After Moreau, return to the @loc{Fallow Plot} scarecrow field in front of Luiza's House before entering the Stronghold.
Find the Vârcolac Alfa roaming the field and kill it; use an infinite-ammo weapon on a later run if ammunition is tight.

achievements.description: Defeat Uriaș during the first lycan attack when you enter the village.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{Uriaș} during the first village lycan ambush before its escape cutscene.

guide.context: A first run lacks practical firepower for this timed kill. Completed-story New Game+ carries weapons, upgrades, ammunition, and infinite-ammo bonuses into the ambush.

steps.text: Load a completed-story save, start New Game+ on Casual, and equip a powerful infinite-ammo weapon before the opening ambush.
When the black-furred hammer wielder enters the ambush, focus every attack on Uriaș and kill him before the cutscene ends the encounter.

achievements.description: Use Photo Mode.
achievements.summary: Open and then close @mechanic{Photo Mode} from the pause menu.

guide.context: The achievement registers when Photo Mode closes, not when the menu first opens.

steps.text: Pause the story, select Photo Mode, then exit Photo Mode back to gameplay.

achievements.description: Have 777, 7,777, or 77,777 Lei in your possession in the story.
achievements.summary: Adjust Ethan's wallet to one of three exact totals: @item{777 Lei}, @item{7,777 Lei}, or @item{77,777 Lei}.

guide.context: Rifle Ammo sells for exactly 7 Lei per round, making 777 easy to construct after the first completion. Make a manual save before changing the inventory.

steps.text: Buy the WCX for 30,000 CP from @loc{Main Menu > Bonuses > Extra Content Shop}, then buy the WCX and the Rifle Ammo recipe from the Duke for 10,000 Lei.
Spend or trade until Ethan holds exactly 0 Lei.
Craft Rifle Ammo and sell exactly 111 rounds to the Duke at 7 Lei each, leaving exactly 777 Lei.

achievements.description: Complete the village map.
achievements.summary: Unfog every named @loc{village map area} in a single story run.

guide.context: A full collectible route covers the mandatory map. The commonly missed spaces are three optional Crank-era detours available after Moreau and before the Factory lock-in.

steps.text: Use the Crank on the gate near Moreau's windmill and enter the @loc{Moreau's Hidden Weapon} area.
Lower the Lone Road drawbridge, ride the boat upstream, and enter the @loc{Riverbank Treasure House}.
At the “Good Luck” sign before the Stronghold, take the left path and enter @loc{Otto's Mill}.
Continue through the Factory; after Heisenberg, reach Chris's sniper overlook to trigger the completed-map check.

achievements.description: Destroy a Goat of Warding.
achievements.summary: Destroy any one wooden @item{Goat of Warding}.

guide.context: The first Goat of Warding is visible in the lit shrine at the village Graveyard beside its placard.

steps.text: At the Graveyard shrine, shoot or strike the small wooden goat until it breaks.

achievements.description: Destroy all the Goats of Warding.
achievements.summary: Destroy all 20 @item{Goats of Warding} across Ethan's story.

guide.context: Goat progress carries into New Game+, but several locations become inaccessible after their story area. Listen for the goats' mechanical sound when visibility is poor.

collectibles.name: Graveyard shrine
collectibles.method: Break the goat inside the lit shrine above the Goat of Warding placard.

collectibles.name: Church roof
collectibles.method: Enter the Church gate, look up at the roof, and shoot the goat.

collectibles.name: Fallow Plot wall
collectibles.location: Behind the left side of the cornfield
collectibles.method: Climb the stairs behind the cornfield, look up at the wall at the end, and shoot the goat.

collectibles.name: Snowy vineyard
collectibles.method: Search the snow beside the far-right scarecrow after escaping the mine and break the goat.

collectibles.name: Castle basement
collectibles.method: After the statue puzzle, climb down the ladder and break the goat directly ahead on the floor.

collectibles.name: Castle attic
collectibles.method: After the five-bells puzzle, climb into the attic, turn around at the top of the ladder, and break the goat.

collectibles.name: Lone Road stairs
collectibles.method: At the first enemies, descend the left wooden stairs toward the drawbridge, look beneath the stairs, and break the goat.

collectibles.name: Missing Owners hut
collectibles.method: Break the padlock at the Missing Owners gate and shoot the goat on the hut roof between the house and shed.

collectibles.name: Graveyard crypt wall
collectibles.method: Pass through the northeast Iron Insignia gate, turn right, and break the goat between the crypt and wall.

collectibles.name: Suspension bridge
collectibles.method: While crossing the wooden suspension bridge, look left and shoot the goat on the parallel bridge.

collectibles.name: Beneviento fence
collectibles.method: Before entering the house, follow the porch left, descend to the fenced area, and shoot the goat outside the fence.

collectibles.name: First Reservoir windmill
collectibles.method: Circle the outer deck before entering the windmill and break the goat at the far end.

collectibles.name: Reservoir switch pole
collectibles.method: Face the route just crossed, look left for the goat atop a pole rising from the water, and shoot it.

collectibles.name: Drained boat area
collectibles.method: After draining the Reservoir, return to the former boat dock, cross the broken windmill, turn left, and break the goat.

collectibles.name: Otto's Mill shrine
collectibles.method: At the “Good Luck” sign, take the left path and break the goat in the shrine beneath Otto's Mill.

collectibles.name: Stronghold spiral stairs
collectibles.method: After the large battle, descend the spiral staircase, look right before squeezing through the wall crack, and break the goat.

collectibles.name: Ventilation balcony
collectibles.method: After shooting the ventilation fan and landing, turn around, walk onto the excavator-shovel balcony, and break the goat.

collectibles.name: Merchant elevator railing
collectibles.location: Factory elevator between B1 and B3
collectibles.method: Ride toward B3 while facing the doors and shoot the goat on the red railing during its roughly two-second appearance.

collectibles.name: Heisenberg hidden room
collectibles.method: After Sturm, read Heisenberg's Diary, crouch through the opening to its right, and break the goat in the next room.

collectibles.name: Chris's underground statue
collectibles.location: Underground ruins after planting the Megamycete bomb
collectibles.method: As Chris, look behind the spikes in the dark corner and shoot the goat beside the woman statue.

achievements.description: Equip a gun with a customizable part.
achievements.summary: Equip any firearm with one matching @item{customizable weapon part}.

guide.context: The earliest free attachment is the LEMI Recoil Compensator in the metal case immediately after the Castle Dimitrescu kitchen.

steps.text: Take the LEMI Recoil Compensator from the case in the hallway after the Castle kitchen, or obtain another compatible part.
Select the part in the inventory and combine it with its named firearm.

achievements.description: Equip every gun with their customizable parts in the story.
achievements.summary: Equip all 22 @item{customizable weapon parts} on their matching story-mode firearms.

guide.context: Progress and attached parts carry through New Game+. Five parts are found and 17 are bought for 1,061,000 Lei; the required purchasable weapons add 600,200 Lei. After every row, combine the part with its named firearm and verify @loc{Pause Menu > Challenges > Veteran Gunsmith} advances toward 22; stat upgrades do not count.

collectibles.name: LEMI Recoil Compensator
collectibles.method: Open the metal case immediately after the Kitchen and equip the part on the LEMI.

collectibles.name: F2 Rifle High-Capacity Mag
collectibles.method: Use Luthier's Key, enter code 27-09-17, and equip the part on the F2 Rifle.

collectibles.name: M1911 High-Capacity Mag
collectibles.method: Open the silver case beside Moreau's Diary 1 after draining the Reservoir and equip the part on the M1911.

collectibles.name: W870 TAC Foregrip
collectibles.method: Lower the drawbridge after Moreau, take the boat downstream, open the silver case beside Analysis Results, and equip the part on the W870 TAC.

collectibles.name: M1851 Wolfsbane Long Barrel
collectibles.method: After forging Heisenberg's Key, enter the now-powered room left of the Foundry, take the case before the B1 boss lock-in, and equip the part on the M1851 Wolfsbane.

collectibles.name: LEMI High-Capacity Mag
collectibles.method: Buy the part for 9,000 Lei and equip it on the LEMI.

collectibles.name: M1911 Improved Grip
collectibles.method: Buy the part for 12,000 Lei and equip it on the M1911.

collectibles.name: V61 Custom Long Barrel
collectibles.method: Buy the V61 Custom for 120,000 Lei, buy this part for 56,000 Lei, and equip it on the V61 Custom.

collectibles.name: V61 Custom Drum Magazine
collectibles.method: Buy for 70,000 Lei and equip it on the V61 Custom.

collectibles.name: V61 Custom Gunstock
collectibles.method: Buy for 35,000 Lei and equip it on the V61 Custom.

collectibles.name: M1897 Hair Trigger
collectibles.method: Buy the part for 8,000 Lei and equip it on the M1897.

collectibles.name: W870 TAC Improved Stock
collectibles.method: Buy the part for 22,000 Lei and equip it on the W870 TAC.

collectibles.name: SYG-12 Long Barrel
collectibles.method: Buy the SYG-12 for 180,000 Lei, buy this part for 64,000 Lei, and equip it on the SYG-12.

collectibles.name: SYG-12 Red Dot Sight
collectibles.method: Buy for 42,000 Lei and equip it on the SYG-12.

collectibles.name: SYG-12 Drum Magazine
collectibles.method: Buy for 88,000 Lei and equip it on the SYG-12.

collectibles.name: WCX Red Dot Sight
collectibles.method: Buy the WCX bonus for 30,000 CP, obtain the gun from the Duke, buy this part for 140,000 Lei, and equip it on the WCX.

collectibles.name: WCX Foregrip
collectibles.method: Buy for 80,000 Lei and equip it on the WCX.

collectibles.name: F2 Rifle High Magnification Scope
collectibles.method: Buy the part for 15,000 Lei and equip it on the F2 Rifle.

collectibles.name: F2 Rifle Cheek Rest
collectibles.method: Buy the part for 20,000 Lei and equip it on the F2 Rifle.

collectibles.name: M1851 Wolfsbane Increased Capacity Cylinder
collectibles.method: Buy the part for 100,000 Lei and equip it on the M1851 Wolfsbane.

collectibles.name: S.T.A.K.E. High Capacity Mag
collectibles.method: Buy the S.T.A.K.E. for 300,000 Lei, buy this part for 180,000 Lei, and equip it on the S.T.A.K.E.

collectibles.name: S.T.A.K.E. Improved Grip
collectibles.method: Buy for 120,000 Lei and equip it on the S.T.A.K.E.

achievements.description: Create every type of item available in the Crafting menu.
achievements.summary: Craft all 11 base-story @item{item types} at least once.

guide.context: The last three recipes require post-game weapons. Recipe ownership alone is insufficient; make one item from every row.

collectibles.name: First Aid Med
collectibles.method: Craft one with the listed Herb and Chem Fluid materials.

collectibles.name: Handgun Ammo
collectibles.method: Craft one batch after gathering the listed materials.

collectibles.name: Shotgun Ammo
collectibles.location: Duke shop after reaching the vineyard
collectibles.method: Buy the 3,000-Lei recipe and craft one batch.

collectibles.name: Sniper Rifle Ammo
collectibles.location: Duke shop after reaching the vineyard
collectibles.method: Buy the 4,000-Lei recipe and craft one batch.

collectibles.name: Mines
collectibles.location: Duke shop after reaching the vineyard
collectibles.method: Buy the 3,500-Lei recipe and craft one Mine.

collectibles.name: Pipe Bomb
collectibles.location: Duke shop on the second village visit
collectibles.method: Buy the 2,500-Lei recipe and craft one Pipe Bomb.

collectibles.name: Explosive Rounds
collectibles.location: Duke shop on the third village visit
collectibles.method: Buy the 3,000-Lei recipe and craft one batch.

collectibles.name: Flashbangs
collectibles.location: Duke shop on the third village visit

achievements.description: Finish the story only using four or fewer recovery items.
achievements.summary: Finish Ethan's story after using no more than four @item{recovery items}.

guide.context: Casual New Game+ is safest: carried meal upgrades increase maximum health, and passive recovery restores enough health to survive another hit without consuming an item.

steps.text: Start Casual New Game+ and monitor @loc{Pause Menu > Challenges > Don't Trust That Snake Oil}.
Avoid recovery items through ordinary encounters and reserve the four allowed uses for the final bosses.
Defeat Miranda and finish the story while the challenge counter remains at four or fewer.

achievements.description: Finish the story within 3 hours.
achievements.summary: Finish Ethan's story with the completion timer below @mechanic{3:00:00}.

guide.context: Pausing stops the timer, and a previous manual save can be reloaded if a section took too long. Casual New Game+ equipment makes the limit forgiving.

steps.text: Load a completed-story save into Casual New Game+ and skip optional exploration and combat.
Check the timer in the pause menu at major saves and reload an earlier slot if the route falls behind.
Defeat Miranda and reach the ending before the timer reaches three hours.

achievements.description: Finish the story without spending more than 10,000 Lei.
achievements.summary: Finish Ethan's story after spending no more than @item{10,000 Lei} during that playthrough.

guide.context: Money spent on earlier runs does not count against a New Game+ attempt, so buy and upgrade the required equipment before creating the completed-story save.

steps.text: Begin Casual New Game+ with the weapons, inventory space, and supplies already carried over.
Avoid purchases from the Duke and monitor @loc{Pause Menu > Challenges > Frugal Father}.
Complete the story while the current-run spending counter stays at or below 10,000 Lei.

achievements.description: Not including some boss fights, finish the story using nothing but close-combat weapons.
achievements.summary: Finish Ethan's story using only @item{close-combat weapons} outside the mandatory Atelier, Moreau, Factory, Heisenberg-vehicle, Chris laser-target, and Miranda-orb sequences.

guide.context: Use the stronger Karambit Knife on Casual New Game+. The live Knives Out counter must stay at 0; check it after every forced shooting sequence and reload the prior manual save if it increases.

steps.text: After one completion, buy the Karambit Knife from @loc{Main Menu > Bonuses > Extra Content Shop}, obtain it from the Duke for 200 Lei, and load it into Casual New Game+.
Use firearms only on the five Atelier bells, the Atelier's roof window and chandelier, and the Armory's cracked wall; avoid hitting enemies with the shots or explosion.
Shoot only Moreau's yellow bridge timber, the Factory Grinder's orange lights, and the ventilation fan's orange light, then resume knife attacks.
Use the vehicle weapons to open the gate and complete Heisenberg's vehicle phase; after Ethan is thrown out, switch back to the knife.
Use the laser pointer three times on the target house, but do not use it against Urias Strajer; kill Urias Strajer with the knife.
Fight Miranda with the knife, shoot only the large yellow orb when the scripted final prompt requires it, then immediately re-equip the knife and finish her.

achievements.description: Get a combo of at least 30 during The Mercenaries.
achievements.summary: Build a @mechanic{30-kill combo} in The Mercenaries before the combo timer expires.

guide.context: Mercenaries becomes available after the first story completion and must be unlocked from the Extra Content Shop. A 30 combo normally occurs while pursuing the eight required S ranks.

steps.text: Choose a stage with at least 30 enemies and learn the fixed spawn order before the scoring attempt.
Kill the next enemy before the combo timer empties, using nearby enemies to bridge travel gaps until the counter reaches 30.

achievements.description: Achieve at least an S Rank on all stages in The Mercenaries.
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{S rank or better} on all eight original Mercenaries stages, including every II variant.

guide.context: S-rank both versions of each original arena: Village, Castle, Factory, and Mad Village. Bloody Village and Bloody River are DLC stages and do not replace the II stages; the paper beside the Duke shows each live rank threshold.

steps.text: Finish the story and unlock The Mercenaries from @loc{Main Menu > Bonuses > Extra Content Shop}. Earn A on The Village, The Castle, and The Factory to unlock each following normal stage; earn B on The Mad Village to unlock The Village II, then earn B on The Village II, The Castle II, and The Factory II to unlock each following II stage.

On The Village, The Castle, The Factory, and The Mad Village, buy and upgrade the F2 Rifle, prioritize damage abilities, learn enemy spawns, and preserve long combos. Upgrade magazine capacity between areas before reloading to receive free ammunition.

On The Village II, The Castle II, The Factory II, and The Mad Village II, use either grenade launcher plus flashbangs and knife, or an upgraded pistol with magnum rounds reserved for armored minibosses and mines for crowd control.
Reach the S threshold on all eight stages; money, remaining time, kills, and combo add score, and the rank still records if Ethan dies after crossing the required score.

achievements.description: View all character and weapon models.
achievements.summary: Buy and view all 76 @item{character and weapon figures} in the post-game Bonuses menus.

guide.context: The Extra Content Shop and CP currency unlock after the first story completion. The full figure set costs 8,900 CP.

steps.text: Open @loc{Main Menu > Bonuses > Extra Content Shop} and buy all 76 character and weapon figures.
Open the Figures menu and move the cursor over every purchased entry until each red new-item marker disappears; enlarging the models is unnecessary.

achievements.description: View all concept art.
achievements.summary: Buy and view all 120 @item{concept-art entries} in the post-game Bonuses menus.

guide.context: The Extra Content Shop unlocks after the first story completion, and the full concept-art set costs 12,000 CP.

steps.text: Open @loc{Main Menu > Bonuses > Extra Content Shop} and buy all 120 concept-art entries.
Open Concept Art and move the cursor over every purchased entry until each red new-item marker disappears.

achievements.description: Finish Shadows of Rose on at least Casual difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Shadows of Rose} on Casual difficulty or higher.

guide.context: The Shadows of Rose difficulty achievements stack, so Standard or Hardcore also awards Casual completion.

steps.text: Complete the Shadows of Rose story and final encounter on Casual, Standard, or Hardcore.

achievements.description: Finish Shadows of Rose on at least Standard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Shadows of Rose} on Standard difficulty or Hardcore.

guide.context: A Hardcore completion awards both the Standard and Casual DLC achievements.

steps.text: Complete the Shadows of Rose story and final encounter on Standard or Hardcore.

achievements.description: Finish Shadows of Rose on Hardcore difficulty.
achievements.summary: Clear the @loc{Shadows of Rose campaign} with Hardcore selected.

guide.context: Hardcore is selectable from the start. Ammunition is scarce, and ordinary enemies stop pursuing Rose after she leaves their room, so bypassing unnecessary fights preserves supplies.

steps.text: Start Shadows of Rose on Hardcore and save ammunition by running through nonmandatory enemy rooms.

After placing the Gold Mask on the third Main Hall statue and taking the false Purifying Crystal, fight the Executioner in the liquid-void arena. Circle the central obstacle, freeze him, and shoot the chest weak point in phase one and the right-thigh weak point in phase two. Kill the Face Eaters, collect RW-Variant Flask 3, destroy the next Sclerotia Core, then attack the back weak point in phase three; use missed overhead strikes as safe openings.
Complete the remaining story and final encounter without lowering the difficulty.

achievements.displayName: It's Starting to Grow on Me
achievements.description: Use Rose's mutamycete powers at least 20 times.
achievements.estTime: during one Shadows of Rose run
achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Rose's mutamycete focus power} at least 20 times on Mold Cores or enemies.

guide.context: Focus first unlocks for clearing Mold Cores that block paths; a later story upgrade lets the same power affect enemies, and both uses count.

steps.text: Hold the focus input on every Mold Core encountered after the power unlocks.
After the combat upgrade, continue using focus on enemies until the combined total reaches 20.

achievements.description: Craft every type of item in Shadows of Rose.
achievements.estTime: during one Shadows of Rose run
achievements.summary: Craft all four @item{Shadows of Rose item types} during the DLC.

guide.context: All four recipes unlock automatically through the story. Shotgun Ammo and a Pipe Bomb each consume one Rusted Scrap, so retain two Rusted Scrap until both have been crafted.

achievements.description: Complete the Bloody Village in Additional Orders.
achievements.summary: Earn at least @mechanic{B rank} on Bloody Village in Mercenaries Additional Orders.

guide.context: Bloody Village opens after A ranks on the original Mercenaries missions. Although B awards this achievement, an A is needed to unlock Bloody River.

steps.text: Earn at least A on the original Mercenaries missions, then select Bloody Village from Mercenaries Additional Orders.
Play as Chris, upgrade his pistol, follow the linear enemy route, and finish with A or better so the achievement and Bloody River both unlock.

achievements.description: Complete the Bloody River in Additional Orders.
achievements.summary: Earn at least @mechanic{B rank} on Bloody River in Mercenaries Additional Orders.

guide.context: Bloody River unlocks only after an A rank on Bloody Village. Its final castle wave contains 100 enemies, but the achievement requires B rather than an S rank.

steps.text: Earn A or better on Bloody Village, then select Bloody River with Chris.
Use grenades and the assault rifle against the Moreau boss, while relying on Chris's upgraded pistol for ordinary enemies.
During the 100-enemy castle wave, stop in each area and clear spawning groups before advancing; keep the multiplier alive when practical and finish at B rank or higher.
